purpose: tighten Ofcom current-availability, take-up, decent-broadband, satellite-affordability and PND future-role guards without product writes

facts: fixed broadband availability snapshot is January 2026
fixed availability covers fixed-line and fixed wireless access networks
decent broadband threshold remains at least 10 Mbit/s down and 1 Mbit/s up
full-fibre take-up is reported separately from availability
download page lists fixed broadband/full-fibre ZIP as 32.2 MB
commercial-premises USO estimate excludes some premises that may already connect via leased lines
planned network deployments are published alongside but are forward-looking
geography/lifecycle binding only; not broadband availability
